Kuvitus: tuulivoimapuisto suomalaisella: Illustration: a wind farm in a Finnish field by the sea. In the middle is a large wind turbine with turning blades, and behind it are smaller turbines. On the right a power line on pylons runs to red houses. There are clouds in the sky, and the wind bends the tops of the birches.
Periaatekuva vaihtovirtageneraattorista,: Schematic picture of an alternating-current generator, not to scale. At the top is the N pole of a magnet and at the bottom the S pole, so the magnetic field points downwards. Between the poles is a copper coil that is rotated about a horizontal axis. The ends of the wire of the coil are connected to two slip rings on the axis. Carbon brushes touch the rings, and wires run from the brushes to a lamp.
Kaksi kuvaajaa samalla aika-akselilla yh: Two graphs on the same time axis for one period T. In the upper graph the green magnetic flux Phi starts from its greatest value BA, falls to zero at a quarter period, is at its smallest, minus BA, at half a period and returns to BA. In the lower graph the purple voltage e starts from zero, is greatest, e0, at a quarter period, zero at half a period and smallest, minus e0, at three quarters of a period. A dashed line at a quarter period shows that the voltage is greatest when the flux is zero. At the bottom are small pictures of the coil seen end-on: the field points to the right, and the plane of the coil is perpendicular to the field at time zero, parallel to the field at a quarter period, and so on.
Periaatekuva, ei mittakaavassa: käämi nä: Schematic picture, not to scale: the coil is seen along the axis. Horizontal green field lines point to the right. The plane of the coil is tilted, and its two sides, of length l, perpendicular to the paper, are shown as circles: the current in the lower right side goes into the paper and in the upper left side out of the paper. The velocities of the sides, blue arrows, are perpendicular to the plane of the coil and in opposite directions. The angle between the velocity of the right-hand side and the field is theta, and the component v sin theta of the velocity perpendicular to the field is drawn with a dashed line. The width of the coil is b.
Kuvaaja: vastuksen teho p ajan t funktio: Graph: the power p of a resistor as a function of time t over one period T, when a sinusoidal alternating voltage is connected to the resistor. The orange curve varies between zero and the peak value P0 and is zero at times 0, half a period and T, and at its peak at a quarter and three quarters of a period. The dashed line at half of P0 is the average of the power: the peaks of the curve above it are as large as the troughs below it.
Illustration: a cyclist rides in the evening dusk. In the hub of the front wheel is a dynamo that gives the lamp an alternating voltage, and the beam of the lamp lights the road in front of the bicycle.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: generaattorin jän: Graph, to scale: the voltage e of a generator in volts as a function of time t in milliseconds from 0 to 100 ms. The sinusoidal purple curve starts from zero, rises to the peak value 12 V at 10 ms, falls to zero at 20 ms, to the smallest value −12 V at 30 ms and is zero again at 40 ms; the same repeats. The grid spacing is 10 ms and 3 V.
